newsitem.title: FRANCE: Juppe's popularity sinks to record low in France.
newsitem.headline: Juppe's popularity sinks to record low in France.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe's popularity has plunged to the lowest of his 17-month tenure with voters increasingly pessimistic about the economy, according to an opinion poll released on Wednesday.
The Louis Harris poll for the magazine Valeurs Actuelles said 24 percent of 1,000 voters questioned were satisfied with the conservative premier, down from 30 percent a month ago.
He had registered his previous worst score of 27 percent last December, during crippling month-long strikes over planned curbs on state welfare spending.
President Jacques Chirac's standing also plunged six points to 33 percent, unhelped by voters' approval of his tour of the Middle East last week.
An overwhelming 77 percent majority backed Chirac's bid to win a role for France and Europe in the peace process.
The survey showed the percentage of voters who believe the economy is deteriorating rose five points to 70 percent. Eighty percent felt increasingly threatened by record unemployment.
